description: Texture-driven clearcoat, specular, sheen and transmission inputs. Camera-facing probes isolate each extension map with nonconstant gradients, mismatched dimensions, shared-image color/data semantics and UV1/transform metadata.

knownDefects.description: KHR_materials_volume, anisotropy, iridescence and dispersion are parsed but not rendered; their authored lobes are dropped with a specific compatibility record. T25 only claims the clearcoat/specular/sheen/transmission map paths.
knownDefects.label: limitation

knownDefects.description: Transmission still uses the alpha-carried interface Fresnel and no transmitted-scene sampling; T26/T27 own the real path. The transmission map's per-texel factor is applied and verified through diagnostic channel 28.
knownDefects.label: limitation
